sessionCookie.name: session
sessionCookie.description: A browser session. Its POSTs carry csrf_token in the body. The cookie's name is server.cookie_name.

apiKey.description: An API key, as Authorization: Bearer <id>.<secret>.

E400.description: The request was refused as it stands.

E403.description: Not allowed, or a bad csrf_token.

E404.description: No such thing, or this feature is switched off.

E409.description: The record has moved on: an undo too late, or a stale edit.

E503.description: In maintenance mode. Retry-After says when to try again.

display_name.description: The key's owner. On the admin list only.

created_by.description: The admin who made this key for its owner. Absent if the owner made it.

request_id.description: On a 5xx: the reference that finds this failure in the log.

join_path.description: The link to hand out, shown in this response only. A credential: treat it like a password.

Joined.description: Either the sign-in finished, or a two-factor code is needed.

role.description: The effective role: never higher than an API key's own.

version.description: The running build. dev when none was stamped.

announcement.description: server.announcement. Empty when there is none.

shortcuts.description: The keyboard shortcuts you changed, by action. Mod is Cmd on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere.

themes.description: Your themes (see the Theme schema): your own list, else the app's defaults, else null for the built-in ones.

themes_custom.description: Whether you have your own list rather than following the defaults.

theme_id.description: The theme you use. Empty: the first.

login_link.description: Your own live login link, or null.

credential.description: Shown in this response only, and never recoverable.

version.description: Send it back when saving: a changed file is refused with a 409.

SignIn.description: Either the sign-in finished, or a two-factor code is needed: send it with the challenge to /api/login/two-factor.

username.description: Empty until a password is set.

login_link.description: The account's live login link, or null.

LoginLink.description: A login link that can still be used. One per account at most.

Theme.description: A colour scheme on the Appearance screen. Colours are #rrggbb. Anything not given is worked out by static/js/theme.js at readable contrast.

id.description: Lower-case letters, digits, - and _, up to 32.

accent.description: The main colour: what you can press.

second.description: Says where you are: active nav item, headings, info.

background.description: The page. Left out: the mode's own.

surface.description: Cards. Left out: the mode's own.

overrides.description: Worked-out colours replaced by name: text, accent, accentFg, second, secondFg, secondText, link, navLink, background, surface, nested, chrome, info, infoBorder, border. Leaving one out puts the readable colour back.
